ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with a low frequency of high-intensity (white) pixels. Macro-level ratio is approximately 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Scattered, non-contiguous white punctate spots and small clusters (mottling) distributed across both lobes, with more pronounced clusters on the lower medial section of the left lobe and the central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with steep interior walls; depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with low pixel-amplitude along the entire trailing edge boundary, becoming more pronounced and jagged near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer margins of both lobes, transitioning to a slightly concave slope as the edges converge towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring; visible in the lower-left quadrant and upper-mid right quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical and diagonal linear white streaks (rake marks) observed on the lower interior regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple healed circular lesions and linear abrasions across the dark ventral surface.
